latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Pessimistic Offline Lock Implementer skill.

- Guides implementation of the Pessimistic Offline Lock pattern, including lock type selection, durable lock manager design, and lock protocol definition.
- Covers anti-pattern audits (e.g., SELECT FOR UPDATE over user think-time, in-memory lock tables in cluster, missing timeout/owner).
- Supports integration of Coarse-Grained Locks at aggregate roots and implicit lock acquisition at the framework/mapper layer.
- Outlines required inputs (entities, session method, topology, aggregate boundaries) and provides a discovery checklist.
- Produces a comprehensive implementation plan: lock table schema, manager API, protocol, UX integration for lock ownership and force-release, and test plan.
